Class EngineConvex2D

java.lang.Object
jaba.EngineConvex2D
public class EngineConvex2D extends Object
This class from the service demand and the saturation sectors of the jaba engine create the list of Dominant, Dominate and Convex Hull point.
Author:
Carlo Gimondi
